en.headline: Driver arrested after assaulting officer during Peak traffic stop
en.dek: A 55-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of assaulting a police officer and obstructing police after becoming agitated when stopped for failing to obey traffic signs on Peak Road on Saturday morning.
body: Police said a uniformed patrol team from the Peak division was on duty near 128 Peak Road around 11.36am on Saturday when officers noticed a private car that had not complied with traffic signs and approached to investigate.

A 55-year-old man surnamed So, the driver, suddenly became emotionally agitated, refused to cooperate and struck a male officer with his hand, police said. The officer sustained a nose injury. Both the officer and the driver reported feeling unwell and were taken conscious to Queen Mary Hospital.

After initial inquiries, So was arrested on suspicion of assaulting a police officer and obstructing a police officer in the execution of duty. The case has been passed to the Central District Crime Investigation Team 6 for follow-up.

zh.headline: 山頂私家車違例被查 55歲司機襲警涉兩罪被捕
zh.dek: 山頂道一輛私家車今早未遵從交通標誌被截查，55歲姓蘇男司機情緒激動拒絕合作並襲擊男警，涉襲警及阻差辦公被捕。
body: 警方表示，今日上午約11時36分，山頂分區軍裝巡邏小隊人員在山頂道128號對開執勤期間，發現一輛私家車沒有遵從交通標誌，遂上前調查。
其間55歲姓蘇男司機突然情緒激動並拒絕合作，更以手襲擊一名男警，導致該名男警鼻部受傷。蘇男亦報稱不適，兩人俱清醒被送往瑪麗醫院治理。
警方經初步調查後，以涉嫌襲擊警務人員及阻礙警務人員執行職務拘捕蘇男，案件交由中區警區刑事調查隊第六隊跟進。
